about: Naigaon West is the southern-most and closest-to-city locality of the Vasai-Virar belt on the Western Railway, home to coastal Koli-agri villages, the Vasai Creek and mangroves, strong East Indian Christian heritage and a wave of new affordable townships. It is served by Naigaon station between Vasai Road and Bhayandar.

faq.question: What is Naigaon West known for?
faq.answer: Naigaon West is known for being the closest of the Vasai-Virar belt to Mumbai city, its coastal Koli-agri villages (Juchandra, Navghar, Khaire), the Vasai Creek and mangrove belt, strong East Indian Christian heritage, and a wave of large new affordable townships.

faq.question: What is the pin code of Naigaon West?
faq.answer: Naigaon West comes under pin code 401207, covering localities like Naigaon Gaon, Juchandra, Navghar, Khaire and the creek-side belt.

faq.question: What are the sub-areas within Naigaon West?
faq.answer: The main micro-localities within Naigaon West are Naigaon Gaon, Juchandra, Navghar, Khaire, the Vasai Creek belt and the Station Road (west) belt.

faq.question: What is the property price in Naigaon West?
faq.answer: Property prices in Naigaon West range from ₹28 lakh for a 1BHK near Naigaon Gaon/Khaire to ₹48–68 lakh for a 2BHK in the new township belt and Station Road, and ₹68–88 lakh for premium 2BHK/3BHK in creek-facing and gated projects. Rental rates range from ₹7,500 to ₹17,000 per month depending on the sub-area and flat size (as of May 2026).

faq.question: How to commute from Naigaon West?
faq.answer: Naigaon West is served by Naigaon station on Western Railway (between Vasai Road and Bhayandar), the closest of the Vasai-Virar belt to the city, with trains to Churchgate in about 45–60 minutes, plus VVMC and ST feeder buses, abundant auto rickshaws and road links towards the Western Express Highway (NH-48).

faq.question: Which hospitals are in Naigaon West?
faq.answer: Major hospitals in and near Naigaon West include Cardinal Gracias Memorial Hospital (Vasai), Sai/Sparsh-style multispeciality hospitals, Naigaon trust hospitals and several VVMC and trust-run clinics serving the Juchandra and Naigaon Gaon belt.

faq.question: Which schools are in Naigaon West?
faq.answer: Notable schools in Naigaon West include St. Anthony/Holy Family-style convent schools, Vidya Vikas and Universal English Schools, Marathi-medium VVMC schools and several CBSE and SSC schools serving the Naigaon Gaon and Juchandra area.
